title: Evaluations
hook: Continuous, managed quality scoring of real agent behavior — sessions, responses, and tool calls.

back.lead: Evaluations continuously monitors agent quality against real-world behavior. Built-in evaluators (13 at launch) score dimensions like correctness, helpfulness, and safety; custom evaluators cover business-specific criteria. It runs against sampled production traffic or on demand.

kv.v: The same evaluators run in dev, in CI/CD gates, and in production monitoring — one quality standard across the lifecycle.
Ground-truth support (reference answers, behavioral assertions, expected tool trajectories) and custom code evaluators hosted in Lambda.

back.hookline: External verifiers scoring agent output — the managed version of 'never trust the agent's self-report'.
